Validator and admission refuse a TPC-DI bundle without a full audit pass.

description:
## Problem
BenchBox computes sqrt(min(throughput/1000,1) x quality) x 1000, not the specification's TPC_DI_RPS, and bundles carry no TPC-DI evidence.

## Owner decisions (choice dialogs, 2026-11-20)
- Label, exactly: "Derived from TPC-DI. Not an audited TPC result; not comparable to TPC Benchmark Results." (CLI, bundle, site)
- Bundle: "a `benchmark.tpcdi` block holding the generator identity and row counts, per-batch elapsed times, the metric (`th`, `ti1`, `ti2`, `tpc_di_rps`), the audit outcome (status, tests total and OK, failed test names, SQL hash, substitutions), visibility executions, the validity flag and the label. Timed rows are named `TDI_HISTORICAL`, `TDI_INCREMENTAL_1`, `TDI_INCREMENTAL_2`. Result schema takes the next minor version."
- "No compliance class for TPC-DI, plus a rule that TPC-DI never counts as 'official' in the results database."
- "A single-platform TPC-DI cohort may be published as a documented shallow cohort ... The seed workflow regains TPC-DI cells only for platforms that pass the audit."
- Status becomes `experimental`. "No TPC-DI run is published until a DuckDB run passes the full audit."

## Change
Plan S11. core/tpcdi/metric.py (Clauses 7.5 and 7.6.1); bundle schema next minor version with the generated JSON schema regenerated; validator and publish admission require the block and a full-audit pass for tpcdi; validate_corpus primary metric TPC_DI_RPS; benchmark_specs entry; label in tpc_disclaimer.py printed and stored; registry status `experimental` and the scale list; run gate opens for DuckDB only; remove step 1's blanket refusal in favour of the audit-evidence rule.

## Decision gates
Exact field names inside the block follow the planner's draft (D33); any name not in that draft is shown to the owner. A DIGen-sourced result stays non-publishable. No result is published by this pull request; publication is a separate owner-approved act.

## Verification rubric
Pass: metric unit tests on worked examples from the specification; `uv run -- python -m benchbox.core.results.bundle_json_schema --check` passes; validator tests for missing block, failed audit, passed audit, DIGen-sourced; through `make heavy-run`, `benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpcdi --scale 3 --phases generate,load,power` produces a PASSED bundle with tpc_di_rps and the label verbatim; `scripts/validate_submission.py` accepts it and rejects a copy with the audit status altered; another platform is refused; `make pr-preflight` passes.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
- The agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`.
- Arming: `make pr-arm` once; one more attempt only when the refusal named a cause, the agent reported it and the cause is cleared; never a third without asking. `make pr-rerun` at most once and only for a job the runner never ran or cancelled, never for a failed test.
- Review threads: reply; resolve only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise the finding again.
- Subagents are read-only. No file edit by script; use the edit tool. Do not edit a pull request description while its CI is starting; post a comment.
- Any limit, default, threshold, status token, message or label text the owner has not already chosen (see tpcdi-correction-plan-20261120) is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- A blocked step stops this item; no workaround. No live cloud run. Heavy work only through `make heavy-run`. One pull request for this item, merged before the next item starts.
- From the quarantine step until the reopening step, no TPC-DI entry point may produce a result that reads PASSED or is admitted for publication.
